eps.t: It's Time for Just a Minute
eps.d: A documentary about the long-running BBC Radio 4 panel game "Just a Minute".

eps.t: Tony Hawks, Kit Hesketh-Harvey, Tony Slattery, Helen Lederer
eps.d: Chairman: Nicholas Parsons. Panel: Tony Hawks, Kit Hesketh-Harvey, Tony Slattery, Helen Lederer Subjects: Eros, an unusual way to cross the Thames, Big Ben, M25, (mystery object - Laurence Olivier statuette), Isle of Dogs, Pepys, Covent Garden.

eps.t: Tony Slattery, Arthur Smith, Jeremy Hardy, Mariella Frostrup
eps.d: Panel: Tony Slattery, Arthur Smith, Jeremy Hardy, Mariella Frostrup. Subjects: What the butler saw at 10 Downing Street, what I did on Richmond Hill, Aylesbury duck, (mystery object - pantomime cat), what you keep under your bed, Maidenhead.

eps.t: Graham Norton, Tony Slattery, Arthur Smith, Ann Bryson
eps.d: Panel: Graham Norton, Tony Slattery, Arthur Smith, Ann Bryson. Subjects: The House of Lords, tipping taxi drivers, the Chamber of Horrors, alternative uses for Buckingham Palace, (mystery object - Queen Victoria's muff warmer), what I caught on holiday, the old lady of Threadneedle Street.

eps.t: Clement Freud, Tony Hawks, Tony Slattery, Richard Vranch
eps.d: Subjects: Double parking, London pubs, the Buckingham Palace shop, Berkeley Square, (mystery object - jellied eels), Tony Slattery's sideburns, Hampstead to Putney by bus.

eps.t: Tony Hawks, Kit Hesketh-Harvey, Tony Slattery, Helen Lederer
eps.d: Subjects: London pride, pearly kings, cockney accent, (mystery object - Yeoman of the Guard hat), the dung beetle, hailing a taxi.

eps.t: Tony Slattery, Jim Sweeney, Lee Simpson, Tony Blackburn
eps.d: Subjects: A try at Twickenham, going to the dogs, Sloan rangers, Cleopatra's needle, (mystery object - electrostatic collector), pirate radio, breaking into Buckingham Palace.

eps.t: Tony Slattery, Arthur Smith, Richard Vranch, Pete McCarthy
eps.d: Subjects: Things to do on South End Pier, why I hate London, where I live, London bobbies, (mystery object - blood circulator), things that go bump in Nicholas Parsons' wardrobe, stains.

eps.t: Derek Nimmo, Tony Slattery, Nick Revell, John Fortune
eps.d: Subjects: My elephant and castle, what I would do with Battersea Power Station, my Wimbledon racquet, (mystery object - widow's scold), Luton Airport, the angel.

eps.t: Tony Slattery, Neil Mullarkey, Tony Banks, Hattie Hayridge
eps.d: Subjects: Heathrow, if I were Prime Minister, Waterloo, (mystery object - mud and water from the Thames), London telephone boxes, the Dagenham Girl Pipers.

eps.t: Clement Freud, Tony Hawks, Tony Slattery, Richard Vranch
eps.d: Subjects: London nightlife, London's finest sight, Roman London, London fiddles, why I'm not in the National Portrait Gallery, (mystery object - David Garrick's death mask), traffic wardens, the London Underground.

eps.t: Tony Slattery, Jim Sweeney, Lee Simpson, Jo Brand
eps.d: Subjects: The London Marathon, Whipsnade Zoo, Ealing Studios, Chinatown, (mystery object - Victorian ear trumpet), game show hosts, the sewers of London.

eps.t: Derek Nimmo, Tony Slattery, Nick Revell, John Fortune
eps.d: Subjects: The scrubs, Margaret Thatcher's handbag, Whitstable oysters, my Saville Row suit, West End girls, (mystery object - veterinary device), Mincing Lane, the steward's inquiry at Epsom.

eps.t: Tony Slattery, Arthur Smith, Richard Vranch, Ted Robbins
eps.d: Subjects: How we survived the Blitz, Sherlock Holmes and Doctor Watson, Barking Creek, (mystery object - fragment of astronomical glass), the first day of the lingerie sale at Harrods, the Lord Mayor's Show.

eps.t: Tony Slattery, Neil Mullarkey, Tony Banks, Hattie Hayridge
eps.d: Subjects: Why Oscar Wilde decided to live in Tight Street, what I would exhibit at the Chelsea Flower Show, the sinner from Pinner, Eton, my Ascot hat, (mystery object - hair curler), the big bang, the green belt.
